titleEn: Count Integers With Even Digit Sum
title: 统计各位数字之和为偶数的整数个数
summary: 统计一到 num 中十进制数位和为偶数的正整数数量。
insight: 约束很小，逐数取模求数位和并检查奇偶即可。
pitfalls: 判断数位和而非数字本身奇偶

solutions.title: 枚举并求数位和
steps: value 从一到 num，循环取 value%10 累加

code.java: class Solution { public int countEven(int num){int answer=0;for(int value=1;value<=num;value++){int current=value,sum=0;while(current>0){sum+=current%10;current/=10;}if(sum%2==0)answer++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countEven(num:Int):Int{var answer=0;for(value in 1..num){var current=value;var sum=0;while(current>0){sum+=current%10;current/=10};if(sum%2==0)answer++};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int countEven(int num){int answer=0;for(int value=1;value<=num;++value){int current=value,sum=0;while(current){sum+=current%10;current/=10;}answer+=sum%2==0;}return answer;} };
